current.text: Giannis Antetokounmpo is gone. Milwaukee lost his 33% usage and Bobby Portis's shots.
Taylor Jenkins is the new head coach. He replaces Doc Rivers.
Projected starters are Ryan Rollins, Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kel'el Ware and Myles Turner.
Power forward is the weakest position on the roster and arguably the weakest group in the league. The team will likely start a center at the four.
Turner and Ware can play together.
It is unclear whether Jenkins will give Ware a fantasy-friendly role or focus on winning.
The guard rotation is crowded. It includes Herro, Rollins, Kevin Porter Jr., Kasparas Jakucionis, Brayden Burries, Gary Trent Jr., AJ Green and Yuta Watanabe.
Herro's role is set. Rollins and Herro are expected to lead the lineup. Porter's role is in question.
Herro, Rollins and Porter will compete for shot creation.
The rotation and the minutes split are hard to predict.
The guards ahead of Burries limit his immediate impact.
The roster has 17 players, so at least two must go. It is heavy on small shooting guards and short on wings.
Milwaukee is expected to be bad. The win total is 26.5, and Justin expects about 33 wins.
Milwaukee does not control its own draft pick and does not see this season as a long-term rebuild. It has no reason to tank.
With no pick to protect, the risk of tanking late in the season is lower than for a typical bad team.

durable.text: Jenkins is expected to push offensive rebounding, a pressure defense that forces turnovers and a faster transition game.
Jenkins probably runs a tighter ship than the previous coach.

tags.name: new coach
tags.detail: Taylor Jenkins replaces Doc Rivers. His rotation habits are not yet known for this roster.
tags.new_meaning: The team has a new head coach this season, so its rotation, minutes and style are less predictable.

tags.name: crowded rotation
tags.detail: Eight guards compete for backcourt minutes. The roster has 17 players and must cut at least two.
tags.new_meaning: Many players compete for the same minutes, so roles and minutes on this team are hard to predict.

tags.name: bad team
tags.new_meaning: The team is expected to finish near the bottom of the league.

tags.name: no tank incentive
tags.detail: Milwaukee does not control its own draft pick.
tags.new_meaning: The team does not own its draft pick, so it has no reason to tank or sit healthy players late in the season.

tags.name: trades likely
tags.detail: More trades are possible after the Giannis deal.
tags.new_meaning: The front office is expected to make more trades this season, which can change roles on the team.

note: With Giannis gone, Rollins and Herro are expected to run the offense. Turner and Ware are projected to start together, with a center playing the four. The guards behind them (Porter, Jakucionis, Burries, Green, Trent) fight over few minutes, and Porter's role is in question. Early on, watch how new coach Taylor Jenkins uses Ware and splits the guard minutes, and which two players are cut. The team should be bad, but it does not own its pick, so the risk of tanking late in the season is lower.
